That winter he took Khotan, and the four western cities of the southern Tarim were declared at peace.
That winter he took Khotan, and the four western cities of the southern frontier (Nanjiang) were declared at peace.
南疆 means 'southern frontier'; 'Tarim' is not in the source.

The rebels had just unsaddled to feed their horses when they were startled into action and drew up along the hillside. Jun routed them, and Fuxiang sent his men in pursuit, cutting down more than three hundred horsemen.
秣馬 means feeding (foddering) horses, not watering them.

The court ordered him to station at Xining with sole charge of suppression and pacification, placing Wei Guangtao's twenty-seven battalions under his command.

燾 is read tāo (or dào), not 'can'.

東西四城 is 'the eastern and western four cities'; 'eastern' was dropped.
